1.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_000
1.description: Ah, <hex:022C0DFF07022903EB0203FF02200203>! I was hoping you'd stop by.

2.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_001
2.description: Ah, if it isn't the unenhanced grand champion <hex:020815E905FF0868657273656C66FF0868696D73656C6603>! To what do I owe the honor?

6.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_100
6.description: Though the light-heavyweight division is the lowest tier of the championship, you surprised one and all by rising up as champion without the use of feral souls.

7.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_101
7.description: And you didn't stop there. When former heavyweight fighter Wicked Thunder unexpectedly appeared to challenge you, you bested her as well. Never have we seen such drama at the Arcadion!

8.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_102
8.description: Like most others, I watched your matches at the edge of my seat, but I've been most keen to hear your firsthand account. Pray spare no detail!

9.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_103
9.description: Hm-hm! Your words have provided me with insight and inspiration both! With a few embellishments, I believe I can produce a story that will grip the reader from start to finish!

12.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_A2_100_100
12.description: You're not going to tell it as it happened?

13.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_104
13.description: Lest you misunderstand, my works are not intended to be accurate records of events. In the name of a good story, I may take some liberties with certain details.

14.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_105
14.description: For example...what if Black Cat had brought even deadlier techniques to bear against you?

15.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_106
15.description: Or if Honey B. Lovely, whose sweet facade concealed a terrible temper, had become further enraged?

16.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_107
16.description: What sort of carnage might have unfolded if the Brute Bomber had stooped to lower lows to seize victory?

17.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_108
17.description: And last but not least, what if Wicked Thunder refused to retreat, resolving instead to fight on?

18.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_109
18.description: In such a manner do I let my mind wander when I produce my works. And this time, I'm confident that I have a best seller on my hands!

19.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_110
19.description: I thank you for taking the time to share your account with me. I wish you continued success in the arena!

20.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_200
20.description: If you've a moment, I would love to hear your firsthand account of your cruiserweight matches. You impressed tremendously as before, overcoming one veteran fighter after the next to become champion.

21.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_201
21.description: My hands were clammy with sweat as I watched your encounter with the Brute Abombinator, and to remember your triumph over the Howling Blade sends a shiver down my spine!

22.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_202
22.description: Even so, my experiences as a spectator cannot compare to those you lived, and I yearn to hear the visceral particulars from you. Pray spare no detail!

23.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_203
23.description: Hm-hm, your words have stoked the fires of my imagination! Yes, I believe I can produce evocative new cartoons that pale not even next to Sugar Riot's works!

24.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_204
24.description: For instance...what if your dance battle against Dancing Green had reached a higher fever pitch?

25.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_205
25.description: Or if the rambunctious Sugar Riot had allowed her art to run rampant, bringing works out of this world to life?

26.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_206
26.description: And if the Brute Abombinator's savage onslaught had become savager still, what manner of hellscape might he have created?

27.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_207
27.description: Finally, what if the Howling Blade had remained standing to unleash the full might of Fenrir?

28.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_208
28.description: Oh yes, I daresay the next chapter of <hex:021A020203>The Chronicles of the Unstoppable Upstart<hex:021A020103> will be a best seller as well!

29.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_209
29.description: Thank you for taking the time to share your account with me. I look forward to witnessing your future exploits─and hearing about them from you as well, of course!

30.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_300
30.description: Ready to share your experience of the heavyweight tier? Wonderful, I've been waiting with bated breath!

31.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_301
31.description: More than one shocking secret about the Arcadion came to light with your rise as grand champion, it is true. But as before, your matches are where my interest lies.

32.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_302
32.description: And what matches they were! Even now I vividly recall the excitement of your thunderous clash of wills with the Tyrant. And just when all thought it was over, the monstrous Lindwurm emerges to offer you a fiercer battle still!

33.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_303
33.description: Truly, each and every one of your encounters had me utterly enraptured. And so, as I look to draft my latest tale, nothing should please me more than to hear from the <hex:02080FE905FF06776F6D616EFF046D616E03> of the hour <hex:020815E905FF0868657273656C66FF0868696D73656C6603>. Pray tell all, my friend!

34.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_304
34.description: Amazing... Yes, simply sublime! Your words have set my imagination running wild!

35.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_305
35.description: For example... What if Vamp Fatale's spectacle of slaughter were even more gruesome─her weapons even more wicked?

36.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_306
36.description: Or if the Xtremes' coordinated attacks reached new extremes?

37.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_307
37.description: If the Tyrant were able to harness even greater might from the behemoth, what carnage would he have unleashed?

38.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_308
38.description: And finally, if the Lindwurm's regeneration knew no cease, and it could revive itself from the minutest essence, could it ever possibly be defeated?

39.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_309
39.description: Yes! With this latest chapter, I daresay <hex:021A020203>The Chronicles of the Unstoppable Upstart<hex:021A020103> will become a masterpiece for the ages! I thank you for regaling me with your visceral, firsthand account!

40.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_310
40.description: Now, I understand that you will be unable to take to the ring for the foreseeable future. But please take heart.

41.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_311
41.description: For in my works, the epic journey of <hex:022903EB0203>, the unenhanced grand champion, shall continue, now and forevermore!

42.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_100_400
42.description: I'm afraid I've yet to complete my preparations. Forgive me, but I must ask that you wait a touch longer.

43.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_400
43.description: You wish to talk? I could tell you a little more about myself, I suppose...

44.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_401
44.description: I'm a cartoonist, as you know, and I primarily draw inspiration from the matches at the Arcadion.

45.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_402
45.description: My cartoons enjoy great popularity here in Solution Nine, even if I do say so myself.

46.name: TEXT_CTSOPN70GABBRO_00851_GABBRO_000_403
46.description: And mark my words, my next series featuring you as the protagonist is guaranteed to be a best seller!
